candidates.review_text: Our experience started less than desirably.  We arrived on time for an 8:30 reservation.  Unfortunately, friends of ours were unable to get a babysitter so we contacted the restaurant earlier in the day and they said it would be no problem. When we arrived the hostess acted as if they had no clue.  My husband got us drinks at the bar, but that took more than 15 minutes.  We continued to wait for our table, so my husband inquired with the host. We were then seated 20 minutes late.  Be ware, there is no place to wait, so the entire time you are waiting for your table you are bumped by waiters, waitress, and other patrons.  Perhaps there should be a limit on the number of people permitted in the upstairs bar area.  We ordered the chef's tasting menu.  Our entire service was completed in an hour, 10 courses in 1 hour.  I have never in my life had food brought to me to quickly.  I felt extremely rushed.  There was a couple seated next to us who complained to the manager prior to getting seated, due to their long wait.  At least they were comped for their bad experience. Now to the food, it was average.  Nothing spectacular, nothing inedible.  Just average.  Our dinner concluded with dessert and our waitress didn't even ask if we wanted coffee; as I noticed other tables around us getting this.  All in all, I was disappointed with the experience, the initial wait and the service. As I stated the food was average.  I have attended happy hour in the upstairs space on a prior occasion and felt the experience was much better.

It's one of the weirder parts of the Reading Terminal Market, and in a place that sells chocolate-covered onions that's saying something.  But it's a different kind of weird, not just having a few quirky products.

The Original Turkey offers a turkey dinner for lunch.  Sure, they have sandwiches and soup and the like but I can get those anywhere.  But here, for under twelve bucks, you can get turkey, mashed potatoes, gravy, stuffing, cranberry sauce, and a drink.  They throw in a slice of bread for good measure if you ask nicely.

Their servings are huge; enough that the aforementioned platter will make both me and my girlfriend rather full by the time we finish.  The food itself is not particularly exotic or fancy, it's simple, homestyle cooking, but that's probably why I love it.

One of my favorite parts: they always manage to serve us quickly; even during busy hours there's not a long wait.  Given that this is the RTM it often takes longer to find a free table than to actually get the food.

I've been coming here for the last 8 years and it was just as good a week ago (when I last dined/drank here) as I remembered it the first time.

Their beer list is hard to beat. Get the Russian River brews (Blind pig or Pliny the Elder are both great) if you haven't tried them, and promise me you'll pair them with mussels and fries. I almost always end up ordering the Ghent (Saison Dupont, fumé, parsley, caramelized leeks, bacon, bleu cheese & garlic) mussels but the other options are just as flavorful. If you're not a mussels person, then I judge you. Juuust kidding. I strongly recommend the duck breast salad (Yuck, salad you say? But no, the duck breast is always prepared to excellent tenderness, makes the dish a perfect healthy/decadent combination). My bf also personally vouches for their burger.

I used to have trouble getting a table here at dinner time but have gotten lucky the last couple of times I visited and got seated right away. But even if you need to wait, just know that it'll be worth your time!

I came to Day by Day on a week day for a brunch/lunch, and arrived promptly upon their opening. I was seated immediately. I ordered the brunch burger (a brioche burger topped with a fried egg, bacon, lettuce, tomato, and onion with a side of rosemary roasted tomatoes and a few pieces of fruit). My companion ordered the smoked salmon platter with an everything bagel, which was described to her as a build-your-own lox sandwich. We both opted for the bottomless La Colombe coffee; I mean, at $2.75, how could we not? The food didn't take too long to arrive, which was nice because we were both starving. I enjoyed my burger, which was juicy and perfectly done, and my friend said her dish was delicious too. About an hour in, we noticed that the restaurant had completely filled up! Our server still managed to be attentive despite how busy it was, and we didn't feel rushed to finish our meal at all. In fact, we stayed for a little over two hours with about 3 coffee refills each. Overall, great food and service, but come early or you might have to wait for a table!

I was nervous because people have told me it was a long wait to get in, but we were seated within five minutes of our reservation. The food was delicious. They did push the tasting menu hard. We needed up getting it. A lot of food for two people! The food came out very fast, a little too fast for us. There were too many bus boys/servers lurking around scooping up plates and such. We felt a little rushed. Overall it was a great atmosphere and good food!

First time at Condesa and I had a good time. The environment is great. It has a nice beachy feel and an open air section as well as a roof top area. The food was great. We had the Coctel de Mariscis (octopus/shrimp appetizer) and it was full of flavor. It reminded me of ceviche. I also had the Pescado Frito tacos and they were pretty good. The fish was fried in tempura batter  so it was light and crispy and had a nice pickled onion and crema sauce. The dessert was fabulous. We had camoyada. It was a mango sorbet with a light airy cream mixture topped with think flakes of lime. I would definitely order it again. Also the mezcal margarita had a nice smoky taste with a traditional margarita flavor. The margarita was definitely made in house and not a horrible mix that most restaurants have. Overall Condesa was great. The staff was amazing and super attentive. My only gripe is our dinner took forever.

Cheesesteak- yes! Roast pork- no

It's a bit confusing to order inside. There are two lines to order from. The first one is for the cheesesteak and second is for the roast pork. Not sure why two lines are needed for that? Anyways, we finally ordered we went to the third line to pay. We waited behind the people who were ordering and paying for our order to be called out. Space was definitely tight! 

The cheesesteak was really good! I would absolutely get it again! Got it with American cheese and onions. But the roast pork...we didn't like so much. It tasted a bit bland to us and felt like something was missing. I was hoping for a wow factor since it's their specialty. I did notice everyone who came pretty much all ordered cheesesteaks. Only the tourists like us, ordered roasted pork. Regardless, I would come again. But the confusion to order was frustrating and would most likely come if there is no wait, as it all took about an hour from line to receiving food.

Pros: Food is amazing. They definitely give you enough for your money. 

Cons: Long wait. We waited 90 mins on a long line to finally place our order. 

Also some of the staff need customer service training. I'm not sure why you have to roll your eyes and have an attitude when taking folks orders. Maybe it's part of the experience and I didn't get the memo.

Need a better system for taking orders and informing customers.
This place is great! The wait line is usually insanely long but we got here very late and were able to order immediately and with no wait. The food taste amazing! Friendly staff too

I had my birthday dinner here on a Saturday night. The food was exceptional. We started off with a half dozen oysters on the half shell. They were good. They were part of a special menu, not part of their regular daily menu. For entrees I had the 8oz petit filet mignon cooked medium well. It was so soft and buttery. I could never cook a steak like this! My fiance had the 14oz NY strip with black truffle butter cooked medium. He liked his steak! We shared the jalapeno au gratin. It was not too spicy and not too cheesy. It went great with our steaks. With our dinner, I had the Pear Grapefruit Fizz drink which was light and refreshing! It seems like a good drink to have during the summer. My fiance had the Whiskey Clover drink and he liked it. We ended our meal with the chocolate peanut butter pie. It was soooo heavenly!!! With each bite, the taste just kept getting better and better! It was so good! The food and drinks were great here but the service was sloooooow. I am starting to hate corner tables because we get neglected. After putting in our orders, we waited almost 20 mins for our appetizers! It's just raw oysters, how hard is it to put together! It was almost one hour and it took forever for our entrees to come out. I was getting annoyed. And it was hard to flag down our server, he wasn't as attentive as I wanted him to be. It seemed he paid more attention to other tables than us. I was seriously this close to calling a manager over because I was that annoyed. But my sane and patient fiance calmed me down. Overall the food is great but service during our dinner was not so great.

I hope this was just a fluke - but I wish I'd been better prepared to wait 35 minutes to be seated! -even though my small party of two made a reservation for Saturday night.  We arrived right on time and saw that the waiting room was packed. There was no place to stand and wait, or grab a drink at the bar. After talking to a few couples around us, we realized we were not alone - and in for a long wait time. Some people had been waiting over an hour to be seated - understandably since they made no reservation. But we did! Yet we noticed on the hostess' screen that there were 7 other 9:30 dinner reservation parties also waiting to be seated!

Finally after 10 pm we were shown to our table. I have to say that our server noticed what had happened and he quickly remedied the situation the only way he could: by bringing our food and drinks out quickly!! The food was delicious as always. 

I was disappointed that there was no apology for the wait time by the hostess or the staff. Nor was there a manager visible to offer a small remedy: like a free drink or app. I guess this establishment doesn't feel it needs to cater to its customers!

I can't say the delicious food and the good service makes up for waiting 35 minutes for your reserved table to be ready, but I can say it turned this low-star rating to a 4.
Long wait to get in but you can get on the waitlist before going. Service inside was quick and it didn't take long to get food. Everything was delicious and decently priced.

Long wait on a Saturday afternoon to get helped (but not to get a table as we were seated immediately). Think they were understaffed but we got to watch as one of the women working zipped around helping the tables who got there after us, surrounding us, and at least 15, maybe 20 minutes passed by before we were able to wave her down and at that point surrounding tables had already gotten all their dishes. I think the restaurant should consider hiring one more person on to take orders because it really did seem hectic for them. 

I was not a fan of the styrofoam plates and cups. We did get water from the beginning. My friend and I ordered the scallion pancake, pork soup dumplings, fried rice and crispy chicken. I technically asked for the crispy chicken over rice but that was not what I got, which I decided wasn't worth arguing over considering the trouble we went through to order and the fact the woman who took our order was stressfully sprinting around the place trying to keep up with everything. I greatly enjoyed the scallion pancake and crispy chicken which came with some spicy may sauce maybe with green onion in it. 

My friend said the soup dumpling wrappers were good but she didn't like the meat filling. She said the fried rice was perfect for her, mostly because she's picky and it didn't come with bean sprouts which she apparently hates. 

All the dishes from the kitchen came on real plates. Found it odd that they decided we would be given styrofoam plates and plastic utensils still given that info. Oh well.

Overall, the food was good, probably will reserve this experience for takeout from this point onwards, but still would recommend.

I went here for Sunday brunch with my boyfriend. I went in fully understanding that it was prime brunch time, and there would be a long wait. When we walked in, there was a huge line, but I think there was one group of 6 waiting for a table. Surprisingly, a table for 2 was about a 20 minute wait. We ended up waiting only 10 minutes. 

There's two dining areas. Its a diner/lounge, but in the daytime, they add tables in the lounge area so they can serve more tables. My bf and I ended up sitting in the lounge area. I really wanted to sit in the dining area cause it reminds me of an actual diner rather than a cafe. The lounge area is pretty dark. It's also eccentrically decorated. I sat next to a painting of a nude lady. Pretty crazy, but it didn't bother me. 

Food came REALLY quick. You would think they had it sitting out, but I ordered the huevos rancheros, and the waitress walked away and came right out with it. It was hot! My boyfriend's eggs benedict came out about 5 minutes later. The waitress said it was cause the eggs were over poached. I loved the huevos rancheros! The chips were crispy, the eggs weren't too runny. It was perfection. MUST TRY. My boyfriend enjoyed his eggs benedict too.

The service was great, the food was delicious. I've been wanting to come here for a while, and I'm glad I did. I definitely want to come back, but next time, I want to sit in the diner section. 

MUST TRY; huevos rancheros.

Omg this is the best breakfast I've had in a long time. My husband and I waited over an hour for a table here, which we never ever do, and it was totally worth the wait! (Not in his opinion, but mine :) 

I am absolutely obsessed with the blue yogurt berry and granola bowl. This is by far the BEST yogurt bowl I've ever eaten!! See photos.. you'll be amazed. I have since dreamed about this yogurt multiple mornings for breakfast and sometimes am tempted just order it for delivery halfway across the city. 

We also had chicken and waffles which was pretty good, but not nearly as good as the short rib huevos rancheros, which to me looks more like quesadillas (see photos). This was also some of the best huevos rancheros I have ever had and the serving size was huge enough to feed two people! 

The cappuccino was delicious and the service was speedy fast because they were trying to turn tables over very quickly since the wait got up to over two hours long. 

I have worked in the food industry so I knew to eat quick and get out but others who were lingering around and drinking their coffee slowly could be annoyed at how they were being rushed to eat and leave. But because of Covid restaurants have restrictions on how many tables they can have outside so it's critical that people be aware that every minute equals money, and they should not sit and linger when done eating if there is a wait for tables. 

The owner was funny, A little rough around the edges, but I enjoyed watching him keep track of a two hour long wait on nothing but yellow Post-it notes. Maybe an upgraded computer system would do them good! 

But the food was so delicious it outweighs everything else to a 5-star rating. Bravo chef!

We chose this restaurant after looking at quite a few reviews on Yelp. We've really enjoyed Thai food pretty much wherever we've been. Thai Kuu did not disappoint.
We started with the THAI FRESH LETTUCE WRAPS, construct-your-own wraps served with crunchy iceberg lettuce and a savory chicken filling. Zippy in favor - left our lips tingling - but not overly hot. Plenty to satisfy two. 
For our main course, we chose
MASSAMAN CURRY and PINEAPPLE HIMMAPARN. The curry was served with five, large plum shrimp in a zesty massaman sauce with vegetables. The Pineapple Himmaparn was my favorite for the evening, appealing to my love of contrasting savory flavors with sweet. 
Presentation was lovely throughout the meal, but the pineapple dish was especially beautiful, as it was actually served in a hollowed out half pineapple. Both dishes were garnished with carrot flowers. 
The service was excellent. We were seated immediately  - just before 6:30. Our order was taken quickly, although we were given ample time to consider the menu. Food arrived within an entirely reasonable amount of time, and it was served hot. Water glasses were refilled, but not with such frequency as to be annoying. 
All in all, we had a lovely meal and a lovely evening.

I've been here a few times and everything I've ordered has been amazing. The wait staff is charismatic and helpful, the food is delicious and authentic, and I've always been lucky enough to get seated without a long wait.

Good food, dreadful service. We waited forever for a
Table that was supposed to be, "ready immediately." Host forgot (?) our name on the list. We were
Finally ushered to a sad, drafty table under a stairwell in a gloomy basement room. Food took forever but was good. 
It's a charmingly decorated place (except basement) and Food is pretty good but management is so bad it almost ruins the meal. Make a reservation, then cross your fingers because it could be really fun.

I was pretty disappointed with the experience I had at this restaurant, possibly because I had high expectations from previous reviews. There wasn't a wait to be seated but there was an extremely long wait to be served! So long that we required refills on our drinks before receiving our meals... and that was another wait to even be noticed that a refill was needed. When the food arrived after about 45 minutes or more! My plate wasn't even full! It was a very skimpy meal!

The table next to us had 3 older ladies who also had the same wait as us in addition to one of the ladies not being able to eat her meal because it was too spicy. Another dish had to be boxed for her because once she received it, her friends had already finished eating.

The food itself was ok, nothing worth coming out my way for again

I am usually a happy regular but I came in today and was disappointed. There was a huge line which happens but the waiting list system was ridiculous and archaic, literally saw the waitress seat tables that came in after us. I let the hostess know and she did nothing to relieve the situation or make it better. We waited forever for a table because at this point who wants to leave after waiting so long. When we're finally seated had to wait at least ten minutes for our server. And we've been waiting at least 15-20 for our food. Mind you I'm writing this as I'm waiting for our food I have nothing better to do. Just 100% disappointed. This was our neighborhood spot that we would recommend to family and friends visiting and now it looks like we have to find a new place.

Considering that we did not have a reservation, we did not expect to get seated right away. But we did!  Hooray!  Toutside dining tables were only half full. We were seated pretty quickly but then waited for about 15 minutes for any server at all to come near us so we left. So we cannot review the food but we can talk about the experience not being attentive considering they were plenty of servers and not many people at the restaurant.

Sampan is usually one of my favorite restaurants in Center City, but my experience last night during Restaurant Week makes me reconsider returning.

I made a reservation for 5 people for 7:30pm.  When we got there, we were told that they were waiting for another party to leave.  We went to wait by the bar area, which is always extremely crowded, leaving little room for us to stand.  We contemplated buying drinks to have while waiting, but assumed we would be seated shortly due to the reassurance of the hostess.  By 7:50pm, I asked the hostess if we could have an update on our table, as the bar area was getting much more crowded with others waiting for tables.  She again said that they were waiting for other parties to pay, without any form of apology.  Finally, at 8pm, we were told the table would be ready soon and were thanked for our patience. 

When we finally got seated, 30 minutes after our reservation time, we were clearly seated at a table meant for 4 people, leaving the 5 of us extremely crammed.  I would've asked to be moved, but feared waiting any longer.  The table was inadequate for our party, and left us trying not to bump arms as we ate due to our close proximity.

Overall, I was very disappointed with the service.  Our long wait was only acknowledged after 30 minutes of standing in an overcrowded bar area.  I will not be returning if my reservation time is not respected.

My husband and I called ahead to be put on a waitlist and were told the wait time would be an hour and a half to two hours. After checking in and waiting in our car for the better half of two hours we went in to see if we would be seated soon. The hostess proceeded to tell my husband that there were 25 groups in front of us and that we would have to wait another hour for our table. When my husband told her we had already waited two hours she said "you've only waited an hour and 50 minutes".  I don't normally write reviews but honestly? Three hours for a table and you're gonna be rude on top of it. I'm in disbelief.

Service was pretty bad. We were not greeted by our server for a long time. Once it was time for us to be seated, they took us to a table in a dark corner and we had to move the table over towards the light so we could see. My drink took forever to come out. Our food also kept coming out separately, and everybody knows that everyone at the table is supposed to get their food at the same time. I understand that it was busy at the time but some things are just unacceptable.

It's always a long wait and it's never organized. Once your seated your waiter takes forever to get you drinks. My last two visits here was horrible. Our server kept messing up our orders and our meal came out before our appetizers. We were at a small table and didn't have enough room for all of our plates so we had to be careful so nothing fell off of the table. It took our server forever to get us take out boxes and to go sauce. I could go on and on but you get the point.

Went for the first time today and ended up leaving before I even had a chance to taste the food.  I was a party of three and was told that the wait would be about half an hour so to sign into the iPad. Signed in half hour mark hit. We were seated at the hour mark and people who had signed in after us were actually seated a couple minutes before us. But let me get back to that later.

During my hour long wait I was able to observe the staff, the food, and their cleaning process. First and foremost the staff is young and immature. Flirting with each other instead of grabbing checks and clearing tables. Actively pinching and poking one another and playing footsies. They also kept reiterating the half hour wait when this wasn't true. 

I realized a party of two that had come in 15 minutes after us was seated before us. The hostess realized this as well and when she said something to the other hostess, she simply rolled her eyes and shrugged her shoulders. No apologies. Poor customer service and organization.

Food came out decently fast which is a no brainer since you're supposed to cook everything in the broth.... 

Cleaning wise was way too quick, dirty rags being reused. We sat down and the server pulled a hair off our chopsticks and I had just had enough. 

We walked out after waiting for an hour. 
Disgusting.
I don't understand all the five star reviews.

My friends and I were SO excited to make a trip into the city for a special treat at Max Brenner. The food was  good but we were pretty disappointed with the whole experience. 
We were happy to be seated immediately but it took over 10 minutes for anyone to acknowledge our presence at the table. Finally a waitress came over and said she was sorry for the delay but no one had told her that we were her table. I thought that was incredibly unprofessional. 
We were surrounded by uncleared tables. The tables sat with dirty dishes and napkins for our entire time in the restaurant. This was so unappetizing and just made the entire experience even less appealing. 
Dessert was amazing but i'll be honest; If I'm going to drive an hour for a nice dinner out I can do so much better than our experience tonight.

We had a bad experience with the wait staff at lunchtime (1:30).    We were seated in the center of the restaurant and got water and menus . We sat and waited for 25 minutes and no one came to take our order.    The people seated immediately before us got thier food already and we didn't get  to order yet.  We left.  This was the first time we ever left a restaurant for inattentive service.

The food was good but the service was awful. We sat down at 1:50pm and waited over 15 minutes just to be greeted and given a glass of water. We finally ordered around 2:15pm. Around the 2:50 mark our appetizer finally arrived. We asked our waitress what was going on, and why was there such a long wait. He kindly explained that the kitchen was backed up, but it would have been nice to know this when we put our order in. Two people at our table ordered drinks. The waiter delivered the drinks but on the wrong side of the table. He proceeded to reach over me to give the other guests their drinks. Some simple table etiquette goes a long way. I'm extremely disappointed with this visit.

I know that I shouldn't Yelp while angry.  I should just walk away and digest this experience before commenting on it.  But I can't cause I'm ticked off. (To put it nicely)
Let's just say that, the length of time spent waiting for one's food should have some correlation to the awesomeness of its ultimate flavor.  And there ain't no food that can live up to a 90 minute wait (from signing in to plates to table). I mean, it's gotta be such awesome delicacy that you'll forget all about the inconvenience.  But I can't.  The food was mediocre and the waiting insupportable. 
And to think we brushed off previous comments about too long a wait.  We shouldn't have, but we've learned from our mistake.  
My wife wants to add details: 
The problem here was not just the long wait. The problem is that people who were seated the same time we were got their food, ate, paid, and left before our food arrived. The problem is that when we asked about the food we were lied to and told that the hold up was the dish my son ordered - the exact dish ordered by the gentleman seated when we were. The problem is that when we became visibly agitated we were offered a free price of cake - before our food arrived. Because what one wants before breakfast is s big piece of cake. The problem is that at no point did anyone take responsibility or apologize. The problem is that rather than trying this right everyone has stopped speaking to us - everything has been brought and taken away wordlessly. In short, the problem is the worst service I have ever encountered. 
Finally, my son said: for the wait to be worth it, the food should have been better and fed to me while I laid in bed watching YouTube.

If Local 44 and Standard Tap had a one night stand, Kraftwork would be the resultant illegimate offspring. It has the look of a cool gastropub with kitschy decorations in the bathroom and outside. 

I ordered the pretzel bites as an appetizer and the short rib sandwich, since it sounded good. The pretzel bite resembled baked bread bites, not pretzels. The dipping sauce was nice though. The short rib sandwich was actually the first I'd ever had. There wasn't a lot of flavor to the meat and the meat was kind of mushy. Since this visit, I've had two great tasting sandwiches, so I can honestly say this was the worst I've had so far. 

The beer selection was good, and varied.  The beer prices were a little high, given that Krafwork is in Fishtown, not Rittenhouse Square or "NoLibs".

The service was somewhat lacking. I went on an early Sunday evening. There weren't that many people. And yet it took forever to get my beers and a refill of my water.  I also had to wait a long time just to get my check.  My server didn't offer any apologies and appeared to be disinterested(like the Standard Tap servers).

The seating was the other weird thing about this place. There were two tables open, one that could seat 6 people, and one that could seat 4 people. I went to the 4 person table, but was told that I should sit at the 6 people table. I then proceeded to see a group of 2 and a group of 3 shooed away from this same table and directed elsewhere. If they wanted to reserve the table, they should have put a sign. I also ended up having a family sit at the same table as myself towards the end, which made for a somewhat uncomfortable situation. 

Maybe I went on an off night. But I"m not real motivated to trek out here again.

Long wait times-- they should change their policy and let people share tables like they do in European restaurants.  We had the pancakes and steak and eggs meals. The pancakes were not tasty at all- had a funky taste. Steak was overcooked and a little tough. Not sure it was worth the wait.

Food was great and large portions - BUT - wait was unacceptable.
No one in front and empty tables all around but still 35 min to sit and long wait for ordering and longer wait for food

I hate to write this but, we had a very unpleasant experience at this place. We were a party of 14. Seated close together in two different tables. We all understand it takes longer for large parties. Everyone ordered the $35 buffet.  We got seated at 8:20pm, ordered and waited 15 minutes for our drinks and 30 minutes for the first meat platter to arrive. It took forever after that for our other dishes. It was like they deliberately try to slow you down to a crawl so you don't eat much. It sure worked quite well for the owner. 

Our server was terrible. He was Slow, not very friendly, unhelpful, forgetful and never apologized for the long wait times. We kept asking for rice since arrival and it finally arrived at 10:10pm. They close at 10pm. Totally insane wait times. Also, the place was extremely hot and we never received several dishes we ordered including our soup or dessert. We all left feeling very burnt. It ended up being $58 a person. I was going to rate it two stars but, that would not be fair. It only deserves 1 star.

We are used to going to Parc which is right next door however on this morning we didn't feel like waiting so we came to Rouge where there was no wait, unfortunately we figured out why there was no wait, and we will not be returning. 
The ambiance is similar to next door but not as elaborate or overwhelmingly beautiful. The view of rittenhouse is just as nice.
The food was a 3/5 overall. The table ordered a bagel, pancakes, French toast and omelette. The bagel was on par with dunkin donuts (maybe better at dunkin if ur there early).  The French toast was delicious, a strong 4. The pancakes were very moist and fluffy but not too much flavor. The omelette was dry and watery and lacking all sorts of flavor. The pressed coffee was the star of the table. 
The service, despite how good or bad the food is, is the main reason we will not be returning. The actual servers were extremely nice and therefore I feel somewhat bad writing this, but the restaurant clearly just needed to hire more staff. We waited an extremely long time for water, an even longer time for coffee, the food wait was just slow not extremely long, the wait for the bill was so long we wanted to leave and the aggravating part was that once we have our credit cards we had to wait another 15minutes to get them back and leave! 

Overall, decent enough food for a diner, not this type of place though, and we will now always wait the extra time to go down the street.

The hostess had a bad attitude when we asked to change tables, They serve you old reheated bread, entrees took forever(more than 75 minutes) but they have cute mini Tabasco bottles.... I probably will not return here in the future, especially considering the pricey menu.

prompt:
你正在为餐饮评论召回系统建立逆向评测集。输入是同一个固定特征下的一批真实 Yelp 完整评论。

当前固定特征：queue_time
中文含义：等位从无需等待到等待很久
用户希望的方向：lower
满足要求的英文含义：["Customers are seated immediately or wait only a short time.", "There is no line and no meaningful wait for a table."]
违反要求的英文含义：["Customers wait a long time in a line or queue before being seated.", "Getting a table takes a very long time or feels like forever."]

请从输入评论中恰好选择4条：2条明确满足要求，expected_direction=positive；2条明确违反要求，expected_direction=negative。每条评论最多使用一次。

要求：

1. query_text 必须是自然的中文找餐馆问题，只表达当前固定特征和指定方向。
2. query_text 不得出现商家名称、评论编号，也不得暗示已经知道答案。
3. requirement_text 用简短中文写清需要评论回答的要求。
4. evidence_span 必须逐字复制 review_text 中一段连续原文；不能翻译、改写、拼接或补字。
